summary: Change the admin superuser password by running `awx-manage changepassword admin` as root on the controller server and entering the new password.
questions: How do I reset the automation controller admin password?

answer_card.title: Reset the controller admin password
answer_card.answer_md:
As root on the controller node:
```bash
awx-manage changepassword admin
```
Enter the new password twice; it is used for the web UI immediately.
